examples.text: yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ iruvedaṃ yajuvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ athabbaṇavedaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ iti'h'āsaṃ purāṇaṃ nighaṇḍu keṭubhaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā

2801.meaning2: (what belongs to) the Atharva-veda; spell or a charm from the Atharva-veda

examples.text: adhikāre maṅgale c'eva, nipphanne c'āvadhāraṇe, anantare c'apādāne, athasaddo pavattati.
sīl'uttamā saññamen'āhu suddhiṃ, vataṃ samādāya upaṭṭhitāse, idh'eva sikkhema ath'assa suddhiṃ, bhav'ūpanītā kusalā vadānā.
yadā dvayesu dhammesu, pāragū hoti brāhmaṇo, ath'assa sabbe saṃyogā, atthaṃ gacchanti jānato.
ath'assa ratho samuddapiṭṭhena vegena gacchanto simbalivanaṃ pakkhanto, tassa gamanamagge simbalivanaṃ naḷavanaṃ viya chijjitvā chijjitvā samuddapiṭṭhe patati.

na tāva, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno idh'ekacce ādīnavā saṃvijjanti yāva na ñatt'ajjhāpanno hoti yasappatto. yato ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ñatt'ajjhāpanno hoti yasappatto, ath'assa idh'ekacce ādīnavā saṃvijjanti.

2807.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: sumbho subho matulo aṭṭhamo ca, ath'assumegho anīgho sudāṭho, paccekabuddhā bhavanettikhīṇā, hiṅgū ca hiṅgo ca mah'ānubhāvā.
tam'ūpanissāya jigucchitaṃ vā, athavā'pi diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, uddhaṃsarā suddhim'anutthunanti, avītataṇhāse bhav'ābhavesu.
yaṃ kiñci dhammam'abhijaññā, ajjhattaṃ athavā'pi bahiddhā, na tena thāmaṃ kubbetha, na hi sā nibbuti sataṃ vuttā.

2810.meaning1: then they arrived; then there arrived
2810.commentary: (DNa) ath'āguṃ sahabhū devā'ti atha sahabhū nāma devā āgatā.

examples.text: ath'āguṃ sahabhū devā, jalam'aggisikhā'r'iva, ariṭṭhakā ca rojā ca, umāpupphanibhāsino.

2811.meaning1: then more; then in addition; then any other

examples.text: paradhammikānam'pi na santaseyya, disvā'pi tesaṃ bahubheravāni, ath'āparāni abhisambhaveyya, parissayāni kusal'ānuesī.

2812.meaning1: then; after that; and what is more

examples.text: tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate ath'āparaṃ suvaṇṇasikat'āvasissanti.
ath'āparaṃ pañca rajāni loke, yesaṃ satīmā vinayāya sikkhe, rūpesu saddesu atho rasesu, gandhesu phassesu sahetha rāgaṃ.
ath'āparesaṃ ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena sako pakkho ñāpetabbo.

2814.meaning1: but then; but now; but after

examples.text: paṇḍito'ti samaññāto, ekacariyaṃ adhiṭṭhito, athā'pi methune yutto, mando'va parikissati.

2815.meaning1: but this; then this; and this

examples.text: yadā kho, āvuso, imaṃ kāyaṃ tayo dhammā jahanti, āyu usmā ca viññāṇaṃ, ath'āyaṃ kāyo ujjhito avakkhitto seti, yathā kaṭṭhaṃ acetanan'ti.
appakā te manussesu, ye janā pāragāmino, ath'āyaṃ itarā pajā, tīram'ev'ānudhāvati.
sace kho pana atthi paro loko, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, ath'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissāmī'ti, ayam'assa paṭhamo assāso adhigato hoti.

yato ca kho me, mahānāma, app'assādā kāmā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti, evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ ahosi, so ca aññatr'eva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi pītisukhaṃ ajjhagamaṃ, aññaṃ vā tato santataraṃ, ath'āhaṃ anāvaṭṭī kāmesu paccaññāsiṃ.

2817.commentary: (DNa) athuso'ti nitthuso. (DNt) thusan'ti taṇḍulaṃ pariyonandhitvā ṭhitattaco, tadabhāvato akaṇo, athuso'ti sāli vutto.

examples.text: atha kho tesaṃ, vāseṭṭha, sattānaṃ padālatāya antarahitāya akaṭṭhapāko sāli pāturahosi akaṇo athuso suddho sugandho taṇḍulapphalo.
ath'ekadivasaṃ bodhisatto uyyānabhūmiṃ gantu'kāmo sārathiṃ āmantetvā, rathaṃ yojehī'ti āha.

2819.meaning1: then here; but in this regard
2819.commentary: (SNa) ath'ettha dhīrā'ti atha etesu ārammaṇesu paṇḍitā chandarāgaṃ vinayanti.

examples.text: n'ete kāmā yāni citrāni loke, saṅkapparāgo purisassa kāmo, tiṭṭhanti citrāni tath'eva loke. ath'ettha dhīrā vinayanti chandan'ti.
osāne'tv'eva byāruddhe, disvā me aratī ahu, ath'ettha sallam'addakkhiṃ, duddasaṃ hadayanissitaṃ.
adinn'ādānaṃ pahāya adinn'ādānā paṭivirato ahosiṃ dinn'ādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī, athenena sucibhūtena attanā vihāsiṃ

2821.construction:
na > a + √then + a + ī
athena + ī

examples.text: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo yaṃ bhattā āharati dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā taṃ ārakkhena guttiyā sampādeti, tattha ca hoti adhuttī athenī asoṇḍī avināsikā.

2823.meaning1: not a party of thieves; not a caravan of thieves

examples.text: atheyyasatthe vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. atheyyasatthe atheyyasatthasaññī anāpatti.

2824.meaning1: perceiving (something) as not a party of thieves

examples.text: atheyyasatthe vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. atheyyasatthe atheyyasatthasaññī anāpatti.

2825.meaning1: and then; or; after that; because of

examples.text: pubbenivāsaṃ yo vedi, sagg'āpāyañ'ca passati, atho jātikkhayaṃ patto, abhiññā vosito muni.
kadā nu'haṃ dubbacanena vutto, tatonimittaṃ vimano na hessaṃ, atho pasattho'pi tatonimittaṃ, tuṭṭho na hessaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.

2826.meaning1: and too; and even; nor even

examples.text: vadanti ve duṭṭhamanā'pi eke, atho'pi ve saccamanā vadanti, vādañ'ca jātaṃ muni no upeti, tasmā munī n'atthi khilo kuhiñci.
annānam'atho pānānaṃ, khādanīyānaṃ atho'pi vatthānaṃ, laddhā na sannidhiṃ kayirā, na ca parittase tāni alabhamāno.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kiṭṭhaṃ sampannaṃ. kiṭṭh'ārakkho ca pamatto, goṇo ca kiṭṭha-ado aduṃ kiṭṭhaṃ otaritvā yāva'd'atthaṃ madaṃ āpajjeyya pamādaṃ āpajjeyya.
saddhāya dānaṃ dadato, māsaṃ adakkhi mātaraṃ, antarāyam'pi sā kayirā, gacchaññ'eva rath'esabha.

2830.meaning2: not worthy of gifts; not worthy of offerings

2831.commentary: (VINa) adaḍḍhā'pī'ti uddhana-pattapacana-kumbhakār'āvāp'ādi-vasena tathā tathā adaḍḍhā. sā pana visuṃ n'atthi, suddhapaṃsuādīsu aññatarāva veditabbā.

examples.text: adaḍḍhā'pi vuccati jātā pathavī. yo'pi paṃsupuñjo vā mattikāpuñjo vā atirekacātumāsaṃ ovaṭṭho, ayam'pi vuccati jātā pathavī.
avinaṭṭhe vinaṭṭhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. adaḍḍhe daḍḍhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. avilutte viluttasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
yo daṇḍena adaṇḍesu, appaduṭṭhesu dussati, dasannam'aññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ, khippam'eva nigacchati.
daṇḍo nāma majjhimassa purisassa catuhattho daṇḍo. tato ukkaṭṭho adaṇḍo, omako adaṇḍo.

2834.meaning1: not within the domain of violence
2834.meaningLit: not in the sphere of the stick
2834.commentary: (SNa) adaṇḍ'āvacarā'ti daṇḍ'āvacaraṇarahitā, daṇḍaṃ vā satthaṃ vā gahetabban'ti evam'ettha n'atthī'ti attho.

examples.text: yo kho pana me ayaṃ, bhante, bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā vedapaṭilābho somanassapaṭilābho, so adaṇḍ'āvacaro asatth'āvacaro ek'antanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattatī'ti.

2835.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of adaṇḍa, neg
2835.construction:
na > a + daṇḍa + ena
adaṇḍa + ena

examples.text: parosahassaṃ kho pan'assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīr'aṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā. so imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.

2837.grammar: abs of na dadāti, neg, trans (+acc)
2837.meaning1: having not given; having not offered

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghe vinicchayakathāya vattamānāya chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkameyya, pācittiyaṃ.

2838.grammar: abs of na dadāti, neg, trans (+inf)
2838.meaning1: having not caused; having not allowed (to happen)

examples.text: yathā āvajjanaṃ na rajjati, na dussati, na muyhati, evaṃ rajjan'ādi-vasena ca uppajjituṃ adatvā āvajjanappamāṇen'eva cittaṃ ṭhapessāmī'ti ayam'ettha attho.

2839.grammar: prp of na dadāti, neg, trans (+acc)
2839.commentary: (DHPa) dadantassā'pi adadantassā'pi dātabban'ti idaṃ pana daliddesu ñātimittesu sampattesu te paṭidātuṃ sakkontu vā mā vā, tesaṃ dātum'eva vaṭṭatī'ti sandhāya vuttaṃ.

examples.text: yass'eva bhīto na dadāti maccharī, tadeva-adadato bhayaṃ, jighacchā ca pipāsā ca, yassa bhāyati maccharī, tam'eva bālaṃ phusati, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
amma, sasurakule vasantiyā nāma anto-aggi bahi na nīharitabbo, bahiaggi anto na pavesetabbo, dadantass'eva dātabbaṃ, adadantassa na dātabbaṃ, dadantassā'pi adadantassā'pi dātabbaṃ

2840.grammar: prp of na dadāti, neg, trans (+acc)

2841.meaning2: gave, offered, allowed, granted, handed over

examples.text: cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, phass'āyatanā adantā aguttā arakkhitā asaṃvutā dukkh'ādhivāhā honti. katame cha? cakkhu, bhikkhave, phass'āyatanaṃ adantaṃ aguttaṃ arakkhitaṃ asaṃvutaṃ dukkh'ādhivāhaṃ hoti
disvā adantaṃ damitaṃ, manussānaṃ vasaṃ gataṃ, tato cittaṃ samādhesiṃ, khalu tāya vanaṃ gatā'ti.

2846.commentary: (MNa) adantamaraṇaṃ mahallako rañño nāgo kālaṅ'kato'ti rañño mahallako nāgo adantamaraṇaṃ mato kālaṃ kato hoti, adantamaraṇaṃ kālaṃkiriyaṃ nāma kariyatī'ti ayam'ettha attho.

examples.text: mahallako ce'pi, aggivessana, rañño nāgo adanto avinīto kālaṅ'karoti, adantamaraṇaṃ mahallako rañño nāgo kālaṅ'kato'tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati

2850.grammar: prp of na dandhāyati, neg, deno, intrans

examples.text: kathañ'ca, cunda, tividhaṃ kāyena asoceyyaṃ hoti? idha, cunda, ekacco pāṇ'ātipātī hoti luddo lohitapāṇi hatapahate niviṭṭho aday'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtesu

tena kho pana samayena rañño pasenadissa kosalassa vijite coro aṅgulimālo nāma hoti luddo lohitapāṇi hatapahate niviṭṭho aday'āpanno pāṇabhūtesu. tena gāmā'pi agāmā katā, nigamā'pi anigamā katā, janapadā'pi ajanapadā katā.

2852.meaning1: free from anxiety; without fear; untroubled

examples.text: yattha n'atthi āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti, n'atthi tattha āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ. yattha n'atthi āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ, asokaṃ taṃ, bhikkhave, adaraṃ anupāyāsan'ti vadāmi.

2853.meaning1: not poor; not needy; rich; wealthy
2853.synonym: aḍḍha, aḍḍhī, dhana, dhanavant, bhogavant, bhogī, mahaddhana, vittavant, sadhana, samiddha

examples.text: yassa ete dhanā atthi, itthiyā purisassa vā, adaliddo'ti taṃ āhu, amoghaṃ tassa jīvitaṃ.

2855.meaning1: without a fringe; with no border
2855.construction:
na > a + dasā + a + ka
adasa + ka

examples.text: kappati siṅgiloṇakappo, kappati dv'aṅgulakappo, kappati gām'antarakappo, kappati āvāsakappo, kappati anumatikappo, kappati āciṇṇakappo, kappati amathitakappo, kappati jaḷogiṃ pātuṃ, kappati adasakaṃ nisīdanaṃ, kappati jātarūparajatan'ti.

2856.meaning1: out of sight; disappearance (of); where one cannot be seen

examples.text: ṭhitena kāyena ṭhitena cetasā, tiṭṭhaṃ nisinno uda vā sayāno, etaṃ satiṃ bhikkhu adhiṭṭhahāno, labhetha pubb'āpariyaṃ visesaṃ, laddhāna pubb'āpariyaṃ visesaṃ, adassanaṃ maccurājassa gacche'ti.
na taṃ yāce yassa piyaṃ jigiṃse, desso hoti atiyācanāya, nāgo maṇiṃ yācito brāhmaṇena, adassanaṃ'y'eva tadajjhagamā'ti.
sāhu dassanam'ariyānaṃ, sannivāso sadā sukho, adassanena bālānaṃ, niccam'eva sukhī siyā.
mā piyehi samāgañchi, appiyehi kudācanaṃ, piyānaṃ adassanaṃ dukkhaṃ, appiyānañ'ca dassanaṃ.
yo evarūpaṃ purisanāgaṃ purisasīhaṃ purisaājānīyaṃ purisanisabhaṃ purisadhorayhaṃ purisadantaṃ atikkamitabbaṃ maññeyya kim'aññatra adassanā'ti.

ye hi keci, soṇa, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā aniccena viññāṇena dukkhena vipariṇāmadhammena seyyo'ham'asmī'ti vā samanupassanti, sadiso'ham'asmī'ti vā samanupassanti, hīno'ham'asmī'ti vā samanupassanti, kim'aññatra yathābhūtassa adassanā?

2860.meaning1: not wishing to see; wanting to not look at

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, cakkhumā puriso āpāthagatānaṃ rūpānaṃ adassanakāmo assa, so nimīleyya vā aññena vā apalokeyya.

2861.meaning1: with disappearing as the ultimate goal; with being out of sight as ultimate purpose

2862.grammar: prp of na dassayati, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
2862.commentary: (DNa) attānan'ti attano guṇaṃ adassayamāno'ti ettha a-kāro nipātamattaṃ, dassayamāno'ti attho.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī attānaṃ adassayamāno kulesu carati, idam'pi me tapasmiṃ idam'pi me tapasmin'ti
idha, gahapati, assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto rūpaṃ attato samanupassati

2864.grammar: pp of na dasseti, neg, caus
2864.meaning1: not shown; not demonstrated; not presented; not exhibited

examples.text: abhibhū hi so anabhibhūto, sakkhidhammam'anītiham'adassī, tasmā hi tassa bhagavato sāsane, appamatto sadā namassam'anusikkhe'ti.
idaṃ vadāmī'ti na tassa hoti, dhammesu niccheyya samuggahītaṃ, passañ'ca diṭṭhīsu anuggahāya, ajjhattasantiṃ pacinaṃ adassaṃ.

2866.meaning1: not poor; not needy; rich; wealthy
2866.synonym: aḍḍha, aḍḍhī, dhana, dhanavant, bhogavant, bhogī, mahaddhana, vittavant, sadhana, samiddha

examples.text: saṅghe pasādo yass'atthi, ujubhūtañ'ca dassanaṃ, adaḷiddo'ti taṃ āhu, amoghaṃ tassa jīvitaṃ.

2867.meaning1: not dogmatic; not fixed in view; not entrenched in a belief
2867.commentary: (MNa) adaḷhadiṭṭhī'ti anādānadiṭṭhī suṃsumāraṃ hadaye pakkhipanto viya daḷhaṃ na gaṇhāti.

examples.text: puggalo upaparikkhitabbo, iti mayhañ'ca avihesā bhavissati parassa ca puggalassa anupaghāto, paro hi puggalo akkodhano anupanāhī adaḷhadiṭṭhī suppaṭinissaggī, sakkomi c'āhaṃ etaṃ puggalaṃ akusalā vuṭṭhāpetvā kusale patiṭṭhāpetun'ti. sace, bhikkhave, evam'assa, kallaṃ vacanāya.
adaṃsu te mam'okāsaṃ, sodhetuṃ añjasaṃ tadā, buddho buddho'ti cintento, maggaṃ sodhem'ahaṃ tadā.
so araññato āgacchante mālākāre disvā thokaṃ thokaṃ phāṇitakhaṇḍaṃ datvā uḷuṅkena pānīyaṃ adāsi, te c'assa ek'ekaṃ pupphamuṭṭhiṃ adaṃsu.
dibbagandhaṃ pavāyantaṃ, yo me pupphagghiyaṃ adā, tam'ahaṃ kittayissāmi, suṇātha mama bhāsato.

2870.meaning1: fact of not wanting to give; not wishing to offer
2870.commentary: (VINa) no'pi adātu'kamyatā'ti adātu'kāmatā'pi no n'atthi, yathā pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇānaṃ maccharīnaṃ.

2871.meaning1: not wanting to give; not wishing to offer

examples.text: paripāceti nāma pubbe adātu'kāmānaṃ akattu'kāmānaṃ, ayyo bhāṇako, ayyo bahussuto, ayyo sutt'antiko, ayyo vinayadharo, ayyo dhammakathiko, detha ayyassa, karotha ayyassā'ti esā paripāceti nāma.

2872.grammar: inf of na dadāti, neg, trans (+acc)
2872.meaning1: to not give; to not offer

2873.grammar: nt, act, from na dadāti, neg

2874.grammar: abs of na dāpeti, neg, caus, trans (+acc & +dat)
2874.meaning1: having not caused to give; having not had given (to)
2874.construction:
na > a + dāpe + tvā
na + dāpetvā

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ, eh'āvuso, gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisissāmā'ti tassa dāpetvā vā adāpetvā vā uyyojeyya, gacch'āvuso, na me tayā saddhiṃ kathā vā nisajjā vā phāsu hoti
kathaṃ hi nāma attanā agaṇhantā mayham'pi adāpetvā pakkamissantī'ti

2876.meaningLit: no receiver of what is given

examples.text: yañ'ca kho sīlasampanno, bhikkhu ḍahati tejasā, na tassa puttā pasavo, dāy'ādā vindare dhanaṃ, anapaccā adāy'ādā, tāl'āvatthū bhavanti te.

2877.meaning1: not a slave; not a servant; free man

examples.text: so khv'āhaṃ, bhante, paṭhamaṃ dvāraṃ itth'āgārassa adāsiṃ. tattha itth'āgārassa dānaṃ dīyittha mama dānaṃ paṭikkami.
uppāṭiya cārudassanā, na ca pajjittha asaṅgamānasā, handa te cakkhuṃ harassu taṃ, tassa narassa adāsi tāva'd'e.

2879.meaning1: free woman; not a maidservant; not a female slave

examples.text: sace, je, saccaṃ bhaṇasi, adāsiṃ taṃ karomī'ti.

2881.commentary: (VIN 2.5.1.1) adiṭṭhaṃ nāma na cakkhunā diṭṭhaṃ. (VINa) adiṭṭhaṃ nāma attano pasādacakkhunā vā dibbacakkhunā vā adiṭṭhaṃ.

examples.text: yesañ'h'etaṃ, sāriputta, aññātaṃ assa adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ aphassitaṃ paññāya te tattha paresaṃ saddhāya gaccheyyuṃ
disā catasso vidisā catasso, uddhaṃ adho dasa disā imāyo, na tuyhaṃ adiṭṭhaṃ asutaṃ amutaṃ, atho aviññātaṃ kiñcanam'atthi loke, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.

2882.grammar: nt, abstr, from na diṭṭha, neg
2882.meaning1: fact of having not seen; fact of not having understood
2882.construction:
na > a + √dis + ta + tta
adiṭṭha + tta

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? adiṭṭhattā, bhikkhave, catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ. katamesaṃ catunnaṃ?

2883.commentary: (SNa) adiṭṭhā adiṭṭhapubbā'ti imasmiṃ attabhāve adiṭṭhā atīte'pi adiṭṭhapubbā.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, māluṅkyaputta, ye te cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā adiṭṭhā adiṭṭhapubbā, na ca passasi, na ca te hoti passeyyan'ti, atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, purisassa kiṃsuko adiṭṭhapubbo assa. so yen'aññataro puriso kiṃsukassa dassāvī ten'upasaṅkameyya.

2884.meaning1: friend who one has not personally seen; unmet friend

examples.text: avantiyā kho, gahapati, āgacchāmī'ti. atthi, bhante, avantiyā isidatto nāma kulaputto amhākaṃ adiṭṭhasahāyo pabbajito? diṭṭho so āyasmatā'ti?

2885.meaning1: who speaks about the unseen; who states what one has not seen (as)

examples.text: aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, ariyavohārā. katame aṭṭha? adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavāditā, asute asutavāditā, amute amutavāditā, aviññāte aviññātavāditā, diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, sute sutavāditā, mute mutavāditā, viññāte viññātavāditā.

2886.meaning1: who speaks about the unseen; who states what one has not seen (as)

examples.text: adiṭṭhe diṭṭhavādī hoti, asute sutavādī hoti, amute mutavādī hoti, aviññāte viññātavādī hoti… adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavādī hoti, asute asutavādī hoti, amute amutavādī hoti, aviññāte aviññātavādī hoti.
na diṭṭhiyā na sutiyā na ñāṇena, sīlabbaten'āpi na suddhim'āha, adiṭṭhiyā assutiyā añāṇā, asīlatā abbatā no'pi tena, ete ca nissajja anuggahāya, santo anissāya bhavaṃ na jappe.

2889.grammar: nt, pp of na dadāti, neg
2889.meaning1: which is not given; something not offered

examples.text: gāme vā yadi vā raññe, yaṃ paresaṃ mamāyitaṃ, theyyā adinnam'ādeti, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.
pāṇaṃ na haññe na c'adinnam'ādiye, musā na bhāse na ca majjapo siyā, abrahmacariyā virameyya methunā, rattiṃ na bhuñjeyya vikālabhojanaṃ.

2890.commentary: (VIN 2.5.4.10) adinnaṃ nāma appaṭiggahitakaṃ vuccati (MNa) adinnan'ti tehi parehi kāyena vā vācāya vā adinnaṃ.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āhareyya aññatra udakadantaponā, pācittiyaṃ.
adinnaṃ nāmaṃ yaṃ adinnaṃ anissaṭṭhaṃ apariccattaṃ rakkhitaṃ gopitaṃ mamāyitaṃ parapariggahitaṃ. etaṃ adinnaṃ nāma.

2892.meaning1: takes what is not offered; steals
2892.commentary: (DHPa) loke adinnam'ādiyatī'ti imasmiṃ sattaloke theyy'āvahār'ādīsu ekena'pi avahārena parapariggahitaṃ ādiyati.

examples.text: pāṇaṃ na hane na ca-adinnam'ādiye, musā na bhāse na ca majjapo siyā, abrahmacariyā virameyya methunā, rattiṃ na bhuñjeyya vikālabhojanaṃ.

2893.meaning1: takes something which is not offered

examples.text: gāme vā yadi vā raññe, yaṃ paresaṃ mamāyitaṃ, theyyā adinnam'ādeti, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

2894.meaning1: takes something which is not offered

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu gāmā vā araññā vā adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyeyya, yathārūpe adinn'ādāne rājāno coraṃ gahetvā haneyyuṃ vā bandheyyuṃ vā pabbājeyyuṃ vā

2895.grammar: idiom, nt + prp, prp of adinnaṃ ādiyati
2895.meaning1: taking something which is not offered

examples.text: coro'si bālo'si mūḷho'si theno'sī'ti, tathārūpaṃ bhikkhu adinnaṃ ādiyamāno ayam'pi pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.

2896.grammar: nt, act, comp, from adinnaṃ ādiyati
2896.meaningLit: taking what is not given; taking what is not offered
2896.commentary: (DNa) adinn'ādānaṃ pahāyā'ti ettha adinnassa ādānaṃ adinn'ādānaṃ, parasaṃharaṇaṃ, theyyaṃ, corikā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinn'ādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, surā-meraya-majja-pamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti
yo pana bhikkhu gāmā vā araññā vā adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyeyya, yathārūpe adinn'ādāne rājāno coraṃ gahetvā haneyyuṃ vā bandheyyuṃ vā pabbājeyyuṃ vā

2897.meaning1: dependent on stealing; due to stealing

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco… sahā'pi dukkhena sahā'pi domanassena adinn'ādāyī hoti, adinn'ādānapaccayā ca dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti

ahañ'c'eva kho pana adinn'ādāyī assaṃ, attā'pi maṃ upavadeyya adinn'ādānapaccayā, anuviccā'pi maṃ viññū garaheyyuṃ adinn'ādānapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā adinn'ādānapaccayā.

2898.meaning1: expellable offence of taking what is not given; offence entailing expulsion in regard to theft

examples.text: manussaviggahapārājik'āpatti uttarimanussadhamma-pārājik'āpattiyā methunadhamma-pārājik'āpattiyā adinn'ādānapārājik'āpattiyā aññabhāgiyā.
